name: Lester MacPhail
original_name: レスター・マクフェイル
source:
Lester is a student at Seidoukan Academy. Lester is very aggressive since he believes that pure raw strength is all that needs to use to win a fight. He has a high temperament and a violent atmosphere around him, and is also very competitive.

Lester wields the Axe Lux Bardiche-Leo, which is a large axe, almost as large as Lester himself.
